headline: Archive-scale sketching, simulation and pangenome resources for metagenomic data
label: Metagenomic Sequence Data Infrastructure
summary: Releases spanning all 4.8 million SRA metagenomes and terabase-scale simulators signal a shift toward archive-wide, reusable sequence analysis.
synthesis: Across these items, the dominant thread is reusable, precomputed or sketched resources that make large sequence collections searchable, comparable and benchmarkable. The SRA release provides FracMinHash and hypergen sketches with an all-pairs Jaccard matrix across 4.8 million metagenomes, while PanGBank offers precomputed prokaryotic pangenomes built with PPanGGOLiN at broad taxonomic scale. RandomReadsMG contributes terabase-scale synthetic community simulation in BBTools for benchmarking and experimental design. KENT addresses the compute side, adapting CuCLARK-l to a Jetson Nano cluster for offline metagenomic pathogen screening with reported speedups of 3.1x on wastewater and 2.68x on CAMI2 Marine. gutMDisorder v3.0 extends the resource model to curated gut and oral dysbiosis phenotypes and interventions. What is new is the shift toward archive-scale artifacts that users can query directly.
